name: Esther
self_text: I’m a non‑binary photographer from Mexico in my mid‑30s, loving the calm of a relaxed photo walk at a slow pace. I’m happy to share my post‑processing tips and enjoy swapping portraits. I’ve got a Nikon camera and love knitting in my downtime. I’m free Saturday morning and ready to explore a quiet, scenic route together.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a relaxed photo walk, and you have to be okay with a slow pace or a moderate pace; I’d strongly prefer that you are the one who learns post‑processing from me, though it’s not a requirement.
